newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - DnB 1996 profits seen rising.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - DnB 1996 profits seen rising.

text.p: Den norske Bank ASA (DnB), Norway's biggest commercial bank, is expected to book 1996 pre-tax operating profits of 2,822 million crowns, up from 2,633 million crowns in 1995, according to seven analysts polled by Reuters.
Four analysts said buy, two said hold and one recommended to sell the share, which was traded at 27 crowns on Monday afternoon on the Oslo stock exchange.
The analysts said the result could be affected by possible provisions for restructuring. DnB's fight with authorities over tax losses-carried forward also put a questionmark on the bank.

Net interest income was seen to fall while other operating income was tipped to rise. Narrowing interest margins have put pressure on Norwegian banks to increase profits from other than net interest income.
DnB will present the annual result on February 12
